name: Save Bulk SMS to Database Only

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pending,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failed
FROM gsm_messages 
WHERE message_group_id = '{{$node['Prepare & Sanitize Data'].json[0].message_group_id}}'
